description: Decrypts statically embedded malware configuration blobs by trying common schemes (single-byte and multi-byte XOR, RC4, base64 layers) and scoring decoded output for config-like content. Activates for requests to decrypt an embedded config, recover hardcoded settings from a blob, or brute-force a configuration encryption scheme.
